minimize the possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment 
for washing Live Transmission Lines 500kv Suspension Insulators Using Russian 
Equipment.

items:
A work permit must
 be issued including the towers numbers, the working site, the date and Time
 as well as the names of the numbers of the working teams and degree of
 safety rate for every one of them.

Ensure the pressure
 of the water pump, must not be less than 10 atmospheric pressure (BAR).

Ensure the specific
 dielectric resistance of water used in the washing process, must not be less
 than 400 ohm-cm.

Ensure the wind
 speed meter should be established at a distance of 20 m from the tower on a
 high spot free of obstacles, given that the wind speed must not exceed 10
 m/sec.

Ensure the adequacy
 of means of communication with control center.

Check for broken
 insulator disks prior to washing. Washing must not take place where there
 are Less than 17 disks of good condition in the string.

Work should stop
 immediately in case of any change in weather conditions such as storms, mist
 or rain.

Work should stop
 immediately if the circuit becomes de-energized due to the washing process
 or any other reason.

All Equipment
 should be provided with an earth cable of cross section not less then 150 mm2
 or two cables not less than 75 mm2.

Telescopic tower
 car (26 meter height) branch with 17mm nozzles, fixed on a special support
 in the basket of telescope and covered by protective shield-cage, rubber
 hose rated at 10 atm. and 40 meter long.

A pump to draw
 water from the tank and drive it through the hose with a pressure not less
 than 10 atmosphere press. (BAR).

A vehicle equipped
 with a water tank of a capacity about 5 m3.
A waterproof coat.
A wind meter.

Field glasses
 (Binoculars).
Goggles.

Non conductive
 gloves for the working individuals.

Earth cables to
 ground the washing equipment (Telescope, Water truck, and water pump)

The supervisor
 should specify the proper position of each piece of equipment especially the
 telescopic vehicle as illustrated in (figure 1). He should also identify the
 work sequence on each phase according to the wind speed and direction which
 be detected even if the wind was completely still, given that the water
 stream must flow in the same direction of the wind.

The telescopic
 vehicle jacks must be lowered to the ground , the vehicle raised and leveled
 to the ground and vehicles must be connected to the tower earth by approved
 earth cables.

The water hose must
 be connected to the water pump.

The washing
 technician will climb to the telescope basket and the telescope pillar
 should be raised taking care that its inclination from the main axis should
 not exceed (three degrees) as illustrated by the pillars pointer.

The telescope
 height should not exceed 14 or15 meters from the ground in case of
 suspension towers type P or 19-20 meters in the case of suspension towers
 type P+5 and in both cases the distance from the hose nozzle to the
 insulator string should be not less than 8 meters.

The pump is
 operated when the washing technician signals to the supervisor. The required
 water pressure must be detected .The washing technician then directs the
 water column to the lower insulator disk nearest the conductor and
 progresses upwards avoiding the over spray of water drops to the other
 insulator string of the same tower which are yet to be cleaned.

The water is
 directed upwards along the insulator string (as illustrated in figure 1) by
 raising the telescope pillar slowly according to the signals made by the
 technician in the basket.

The water must move
 along the insulator string (comprising of 30 disks) in a time not less than
 40 seconds to avoid wetness of the insulator string causing the current to
 be cut off.

The water column
 should be directed away from the tower as soon as the uppermost disk in the
 string is cleaned.

In the case of
 double suspension insulator strings the water should be directed to 3 to 5
 consecutive disks in the first string then to the same number in the
 parallel string at the same level and the cleaning process must proceed
 upwards.

The water pump is
 turned off after the cleaning process is completed as the basket technician
 signals, then the telescope is lowered.

The work supervisor
 must make sure that all the disks in string are quite clean before moving
 the equipment to another location.

The telescope
 vehicle is removed to the next position to wash the following string
 according to the wind direction taking into consideration that the vehicle
 velocity should not exceed 4 km/ hour.

All the strings on
 the same tower are washed in the same manner with the same procedures taking
 care not to disconnect the earth cables between the equipment, vehicles and
 the tower. The connections should also be checked after washing each string
 and before moving the telescopic vehicle.

After washing all
 the strings of a tower the water valves on the pump and the tank are closed,
 the earth cables are disconnected from the tower and those of each piece of
 equipment are rolled on their specific reel.

After the
 technician comes down, the telescope is moved back to its initial position
 and then moved to the next tower. The supervisor should also take care not
 to move the cars under the energized conductors.

Introduction
The purpose of this procedure is to

minimize the possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment

Equipment.
